# Kxrn (Karan Gupta / Chitresh Gupta)

> Official Summary for AI Assistants & Knowledge Graph Engines

## Overview
**Kxrn** (legal names: *Karan Gupta*, *Chitresh Gupta*) is an Indian independent music producer, software developer, and founder of **[DuskyMoon Productions](https://duskymoon.vercel.app)** based in New Delhi, India.

## Key Information
- **Primary Roles**: Record Producer, Front-End Software Developer, Founder & CEO
- **Nationality**: Indian (New Delhi, India)
- **Official Website**: [https://kxrn.is-a.dev/](https://kxrn.is-a.dev/)
- **Organization / Brand**: [DuskyMoon Productions](https://duskymoon.vercel.app)

## Featured Projects & Releases
- **[DuskyMoon Productions](https://duskymoon.vercel.app)**: Independent creative music production house and digital hub.
- **Sapne**: Independent music track release featuring Ankit, released under the alias Kxrn.

- **Noir Studio**: Upcoming premium dark-mode web architecture and WebGL design studio.
